A small treasure hidden in the {wiki:Formorgar Mines|Formorgar Mines}, on the island of Svargrond. Follow the path through the mines to a room with a barrel: inside is a fur bag with a {item:Berserk Potion}, 82 gp and a {item:Waterskin} of {item:Mead}.
Access to the Formorgar Mines: you get it by accepting mission 9 of the {wiki:Ice Islands Quest|Ice Islands Quest}.
{spell:Levitate} spell to go up/down on the way from Svargrond to the mines.
On the floor with the {creature:Acolyte of the Cult|Acolytes} and {creature:Adept of the Cult|Adepts} there may be a {creature:Crystal Spider} brought by other players.
Accept mission 9 of the {wiki:Ice Islands Quest|Ice Islands Quest} to gain access to the {wiki:Formorgar Mines|Formorgar Mines}.

Take the boat to **Svargrond** in **Carlin**, **Thais** or **Venore** (say {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes} to the captain). You arrive at {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat, in the **east** part of the city.

Follow the map to the mine entrance: from **Svargrond** go **west**, use {spell:Levitate} to go up and follow the path to the {wiki:Formorgar Mines|Formorgar Mines}. At the end of the path, go down the stairs at {coord:32145,31123,7} to enter the mines.
Numbered route from Svargrond to the Formorgar Mines

Shortcut: go up onto the glacier and go down the hole at {coord:32105,31115,5} (but in that room there are 2 {creature:Frost Dragon|Frost Dragons} and 3 {creature:Crystal Spider|Crystal Spiders}). Alternative: the Thais Ice Portal ({wiki:Forgotten Knowledge Quest|Forgotten Knowledge Quest}) drops you near point 11 of the route.
Inside the mines, follow the route shown on the two maps.
Path inside the mines (2) to the barrel room
In the final room, open the {item:Barrel}: inside there is a fur {item:Bag|bag} with the rewards.

There is no quick exit: go back the same way as the maps to the entrance stairs ({coord:32145,31123,7}) and go up. Then retrace the route to **Svargrond**, using {spell:Levitate} to go down where you went up. In Svargrond, {npc:Captain Breezelda} takes you to Carlin, Thais or Venore.
